title: Kid Mode
summary: A friendly chore dashboard for kids with streaks, stars, and parent approval.

cards.heading: What Kid Mode does
cards.body: Kid Mode turns any note tagged **chores** into a bright, kid-friendly dashboard with streaks, approvals, and gentle celebrations when tasks get done.

cards.heading: Setting up your first kid
cards.body: Tap **Add kid**, pick a name and colour. Then create a note with the category **chores** and add checklist items — those become the tappable chores.

cards.heading: Approving completed chores
cards.body: When your kid taps a chore done, it appears as **Waiting for grown-up**. Tap the checkmark to approve. Rewards only unlock after your approval.

cards.heading: Tip: Celebrate the streak
cards.body: **Tip:** Approving a chore triggers confetti and a small haptic buzz. Kids remember the moment, not the reward — the celebration is the point.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Kid Mode does not create separate accounts. Every kid's dashboard reads the same phone. Set a PIN in Settings if you want privacy for grown-up notes.
